title: [RFC] Using a package manager for plugins
comments: A package registry/discovery workflow remains a valid long-term ecosystem request.

title: Assign a template to a note with keyword in note title
comments: Automatic template selection from a title keyword remains useful.

title: Quick Capture - append date to added task
comments: Adding evaluated date/time tokens to captured text remains a useful enhancement.

title: Help Documentation around Templates
comments: Templating documentation and approachable examples remain valuable.

title: template {{variable}} reuse
comments: Modern templating reuses prompted variables across a template; original multi-prompt pain is largely gone.

title: Allow non-string JSON defaults
comments: Structured/non-string settings defaults remain useful for plugin authors.

title: Settings: Link Button
comments: A link/button settings control type remains useful for docs and actions.

title: Settings: Static Object
comments: Static explanatory text/headings in settings (info type) remains useful; overlaps #215.

title: Allow other date styles in /process date offsets
comments: Locale-aware alternate date styles in /process date offsets remain useful.

title: Add a customisable button to the first page of keyboard row controls on iOS
comments: A configurable first-row iOS keyboard button remains a valid workflow improvement.

title: Task Sweeper is not moving instead of rescheduling tasks
comments: Task Sweeper is no longer in the active plugins tree; superseded by later task automation plugins.

title: In-line/refreshable templates (data-view v1)
comments: Reactive inline/refreshable templates (data-view) have not been replaced by ordinary template insertion.

title: Pane heading (now shows folder) should instead contain (editable) filename
comments: Editable filenames in split-pane titles remain a valid UI request.

title: Adding a #title to x-callback-url using filename causes the link to fail
comments: Fragment/#title handling in filename callback URLs remains a concrete compatibility bug.

title: Clickable portion of links is way too small
comments: Link hit-target / cursor feedback issue remains actionable.

title: References section should ignore the @Templates folder
comments: Excluding @Templates from References remains useful.

title: Remove nmn.Templates from active use
comments: np.Templating is the active templating stack; legacy nmn.Templates is no longer in the tree.

title: [FEATURE] Templating feature request: Composability in Templating
comments: Template include/import composability now exists (include/import in np.Templating).

title: Create sorting API and use it for plugin list (and beyond)
comments: Locale/emoji-aware sorting utility for plugin lists (and elsewhere) remains useful.

title: `noteplan-cli plugin:create` fails because of "missing" .gitconfig, and using different email addresses
comments: Old plugin:create Git identity / .gitconfig failures; stale relative to current CLI workflows.

title: Improve visibility of plugin details to 'ordinary' users
comments: Making plugin docs/changelogs more visible to ordinary users remains useful.

title: Rationalise some Event-related plugin and commands
comments: Event-related command overlap and naming still merit a scoped rationalisation.

title: Plugin Preferences pane doesn't scroll L-R
comments: Horizontal scrolling for long JSON settings remains a usability bug.

title: Plugin Preferences pane 'string' field can lose cursor as it doesn't grow taller when needed
comments: Multiline string fields should grow while editing so the cursor is not lost.

title: Extending the various .insertParagraph... API calls
comments: Return values and richer indentation support on insertParagraph* would help reliable edits.

title: UI bug in monthly calendar view
comments: Cancelled tasks should not appear as incomplete in monthly calendar overview.

title: sync lines and numbered lists bug
comments: Synced-line operations should preserve numbered-list paragraph types.

title: Add markdown view for published notes so we could use https://markwhen.com/
comments: markwhen.com-specific published-markdown view proposal is stale with no current demand signal.

title: Allow separate theming of front matter in notes
comments: Separate theming (and optionally collapsing) of frontmatter remains useful.

title: Make noteplan-cli work with SetApp
comments: SetApp path quirks for the legacy CLI are obsolete relative to current distribution.

title: QuickAdd Plugin (more of an "how to" than a "feature request", actually)
comments: Primarily a how-to about dynamic dates in Quick Capture; docs/examples would close it.

title: Modifier keys alter options in CommandBar and mod buttons for iphone
comments: CommandBar results expose keyModifiers; helpers use them (chooseOptionWithModifiers, chooseFolder).

title: AutoTimeBlocking feature request: Add user preference to indicate which calendars to reference when running /atb
comments: Per-calendar include/exclude for AutoTimeBlocking remains useful.

title: Unnecessary plugin log report on missing settings.json file
comments: Missing optional settings.json still logged as an error; should be quiet when plugin has no settings.

title: Viewing the log file for iOS more easily
comments: Easier in-app access to plugin logs on iOS remains highly useful for debugging.

title: Templating: Add location: cursor to standard templates (esp meeting notes)
comments: Engine supports location:cursor; request is to add it to standard meeting-note templates.

title: Highlighting 'error' text in Plugin Console
comments: Severity highlighting (errors) in the Plugin Console remains useful.

title: Editor.paragraphRangeAtCharacterIndex returns a strange result for the end of the selection
comments: paragraphRangeAtCharacterIndex end-of-selection behaviour needs a clear contract or fix.

title: API Bug: infinite loop possible with plugin settings
comments: Settings-update callbacks can recurse; needs guardrails or documented safe pattern.

title: Allow paragraph.type to be extended (beyond checklists)
comments: Extensible paragraph.type beyond checklists remains a valid platform capability (updated 2025).

title: addTheme doesn't seem to work
comments: Editor.addTheme reliability/docs need clarification or a fix.

title: Extend HTMLView to work as dialog box returning data
comments: HTMLView windows exist, but an awaitable modal dialog returning data is still not a first-class API.

title: We need a reliable way to open a note by filename and replace the contents
comments: Reliable open-by-filename and replace-contents remains important for plugin correctness.

title: Be able to re-use windows/splits by plugins
comments: HTMLView customId, htmlWindows, focus, and showWindowWithOptions support reusable windows.

title: add blockID to the openNote x-callback with filename
comments: Opening a note by filename and jumping to a blockID remains useful.

title: Q: How to get editor when HTML window has focus
comments: Documented pattern for Editor access while an HTML window has focus is still needed.

title: np:Templating: Add writeUnderHeading field
comments: writeUnderHeading is implemented in the templating write flow (NPEditor.writeNoteContents).

title: Plugin settings number box bug
comments: Locale thousands separators can make number settings uneditable.

title: Templating issue - code fences are getting wiped out
comments: Code fences / non-frontmatter dashes must be preserved during rendering.

title: Templating: prompt text including commas does not work properly
comments: Quoted prompt text containing commas should parse without truncation.

title: Task Automation with Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly, and 7-day lists
comments: Support for weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly review lists remains useful.

title: np.Templating: provide interface to moment
comments: Exposing Moment.js specifically is stale; prefer NotePlan/date helpers.

title: np.Templating: date.add and subtract and business add API/docs need normalization
comments: date.add/subtract/business-add signatures and docs should be normalised.

title: New DataStore.fileExists(pathname) API call
comments: DataStore.fileExists() is in flow-typed and used by plugins.

title: Place cursor in template
comments: Post-insert cursor placeholder (e.g. <%|%>) is distinct from location:cursor and still requested.

title: Templating: add to both top and bottom of the note from templates
comments: Writing to both top (e.g. frontmatter) and body from one template remains useful.

title: Trigger firing unexpectedly
comments: Triggers should not fire on mere menu open/navigation without content changes.

title: Add onThemeChange trigger
comments: onThemeChange trigger still wanted for HTMLView/CSS regeneration; helpers still comment waiting for it.

title: Smarter share sheet to avoid breaking triggers
comments: Share-sheet prepend should not break frontmatter/triggers; smart insert point needed.

title: RegEx Pipeline Plugin, anyone?
comments: User-configured regex pipeline plugin remains a reasonable extension idea.

title: noteplan plugin:dev - remove some commands
comments: Stale CLI cleanup of obsolete plugin:dev commands/flags.

title: npc plugin:dev -wc shared.AI doesn't work
comments: Legacy plugin:dev -wc shared.AI failure; low priority vs current tooling.

title: calendarNoteByDateString() not working for uninitialised notes
comments: calendarNoteByDateString still documented as possibly undefined for uncreated notes; parity with calendarNoteByDate not evidenced.

title: .prependParagraph() not respecting frontmatter
comments: prependParagraph must not insert inside YAML frontmatter.

title: Templating: Make docs clear about two dashes
comments: Frontmatter vs content two-dash delimiter behaviour still needs clearer docs.

title: Extend openNoteByFilename() to create new Calendar notes if missing
comments: openNoteByFilename creating missing calendar notes remains useful (updated late 2023).

title: Tomorrow Option for Task Automations Plug-in
comments: A tomorrow option in Task Automations remains useful.

title: Meeting notes plug-in checks to see if note already exists
comments: Meeting-note flow now checks for an existing note and can open it (forceNewNote bypass exists).

title: Search Extensions: run from template and pass back the results
comments: Template-callable search returning results remains a useful integration.

title: Preserve original Sorting from Todolist
comments: Preserve original todolist sort order option remains useful.

title: Rich Text Output Window Not Opening
comments: 2023 one-off rich list window failure; no current reproducible evidence.

title: Automatic Reference in Daily Note to Moved Content
comments: Leaving a backlink/audit trail when moving content remains useful.

title: Updating File Names based on Note Titles
comments: Optional title→filename sync remains useful but needs careful link safety.

title: Habits/Summaries - add chart view
comments: HTML chart view for tracked habits/summaries remains a valid enhancement.

title: Dashboard: hover actions to convert paragraph type
comments: Hover/quick actions to convert paragraph type remain useful.

title: Dashboard: vertical spacing
comments: Vertical spacing/alignment polish for checkbox/icon rows.

title: Dashboard: todos by #tag (view?)
comments: Dashboard TAG section and tag/mention filtering infrastructure now exist.

title: Day & Goal Progress
comments: Today-focused day & goal progress reporting remains useful.

title: Location for Weather
comments: Weather location resolution needs a reproducible permission/fallback fix.

title: Low Priority: Malformed repeats
comments: Valid NP-generated repeats should not warn as malformed (P-1).

title: DateAutomations - Allow setting of >date instead of [[date]] for /dln
comments: Allow /dln to use >date instead of [[date]] remains a small useful preference.

title: Method to open Plugin Settings screen for a particular plugin
comments: Deep-link/open Plugin Settings for a specific plugin remains useful for Dashboard/Reviews.

title: Search Extensions: support custom note title
comments: Separating saved-search identity from display title remains useful.

title: Event Helpers  *|MEETINGNOTE|* using wrong template file
comments: MEETINGNOTE template lookup must not pick deleted/trash templates with colliding names.

title: Window Tools: clone split / swap splits
comments: Clone split / swap splits remain useful if core window APIs allow.

title: Templating: allow import name to be dynamic
comments: Dynamic import/template name selection remains useful.

title: Dashboard bug: add checklist item sometimes doesn't work
comments: Intermittent add-checklist failure (undefined filename path) remains actionable.

title: Templating - Web Service Call and Markdown Tables
comments: Web-service output must preserve Markdown table line breaks.

title: Feature Request: Table of Contents
comments: Generate linked TOC from headings remains broadly useful.

title: Add command to download the latest version of all plugins you have (if there are any updates available)
comments: Explicit bulk 'update all installed plugins' command (e.g. from a daily template) is still a gap vs per-plugin updates.

title: HTMLView failing to update (occasionally)
comments: Intermittent failure to refresh an existing HTMLView remains high priority (P-7).

title: .mentions is empty
comments: note.mentions empty when it should not; related to #183.

title: Occasional loss of a requiredFile in HTMLView
comments: Occasional loss of requiredFiles (e.g. CSS) remains a correctness issue.

title: DataStore.calendarNoteByDate(..., 'quarter') returns wrong quarter
comments: calendarNoteByDate(..., 'quarter') wrong quarter near timezone boundaries.

title: Link to create meeting note doesn't create link to event or allow reloading of note once created
comments: Create-meeting-note link should persist event association and reopen existing note.

title: Templating: week number in templates should use NP API to get NP week, not isoWeek
comments: Template week numbers should use NotePlan week start, not raw isoWeek.

title: Repeat not working when task is checked in Daily Note
comments: Completing a scheduled repeat from a daily note should generate next occurrence (may need save of origin note).

title: removeParagraphs() API not always working
comments: Intermittent removeParagraphs() failure is a data-integrity issue (seen from Filer).

title: Dashboard: option to have multiple #sections and hide items in multiple sections
comments: Multiple configurable #tag sections with cross-section hiding remains useful beyond single TAG section.

title: Helpers: Add hierarchy to the chooseFolder helper
comments: Filtered folder lists still show misleading indent hierarchy; not fully fixed by includeFolderPath.

title: Tidy: Conflicted Copies - links to open in split view
comments: Open original + conflicted copy in split from Conflicted Copies report remains useful.

title: Move done tasks to note
comments: Move/archive done tasks to a note remains a useful workflow command.

title: Synced repeating tasks duplicated on completion
comments: Synced repeating tasks can duplicate on completion; needs single next instance.

title: New and Edited notes creates backlink in Daily Notes
comments: Auto backlink of new/edited notes into daily notes remains useful if activity metadata is reliable.

title: Continue Project reviews after Complete
comments: Continue to next project review after Complete (updated 2026) remains a small workflow win.

title: Readwise: tags with spaces are not supported
comments: Tags with spaces need safe normalisation before frontmatter write.

title: Help with updating plugin library dependencies properly in Node 22+
comments: Shared work to keep plugin dependency install working on Node 22+.

title: MOC: Adding flexibility
comments: More flexible MOC generation (calendar notes, tags, refresh) remains useful.
